label: preparing
what: A surprise gathering/community supper in the great hall at eighteen on day 1, with at least eight lanterns and a target of two hundred fresh loaves, and plans to bring the mayor in without revealing the surprise. The mayor was told of an approved hospitality meeting, but the record does not show disclosure of the surprise. Builder and freight are strongly supported as collaborators; innkeeper's later bread procurement supports participation. Baker appears as a bread supplier, but knowing assistance with the concealed surprise is not established; no other knowing helpers are established.
